text:
sophia: Quick question — offboarding next week and need to confirm docs we collect for 401k rollover + HSA COBRA transition. Employee wants to roll 401k to an external IRA and continue HSA via COBRA. What exact forms do we need from them and from the vendor? :thinking_face:

mike: For 401k rollover we need the completed 'Distribution Request' from Vanguard (or trustee), and proof of new IRA account (account statement or acceptance letter). Also signed election that they're doing a direct rollover vs cash distribution. :page_with_curl:

elaine: For HSA COBRA it's the COBRA election form (signed) and proof of payment method — they must opt into COBRA within 60 days. Our vendor needs the signed election and the effective date. We also need to record the last HSA contribution date for prorated employer contributions. :calendar:

jack: Two quick clarifications: 1) do we require med/dep documentation for the HSA continuation? 2) is a screenshot of an IRA account portal page acceptable as "proof"?

mike: 1) No, HSA COBRA doesn't need additional medical dependency docs. 2) Screenshot is acceptable only if it clearly shows account holder name, account number (partial ok), and custodian name + timestamp. Prefer the official acceptance letter or stmt PDF though.

elaine: Also add this to the checklist for benefits team intake: which contribution buckets were used (pre-tax vs post-tax) so payroll can reconcile the final payroll run. I'll paste the checklist snippet below.

elaine: ```
Required from employee: 
- Signed 401k distribution/rollover election (direct rollover)
- Proof of receiving IRA account details (stmt or acceptance email)
- Signed HSA COBRA election form
- Payment method for HSA COBRA (card/ACH info)
Optional but preferred: PDF statements rather than screenshots

Required from vendor (record for our file):
- Vendor confirmation of incoming rollover processing (email or ticket)
- COBRA enrollment confirmation and effective date
- Breakdown of last employer HSA contributions and dates
```

benefits-bot: New intake created: #INT-4321, assigned to elaine. Deadline for collection: 2026-04-07. :robot_face:

sophia: Perfect — thanks. One more: if employee already received a small distribution check accidentally (cashout) and then wants to roll it within 60 days, do we still support direct rollover help?

mike: If they cashed a check (to themselves), it's an indirect rollover. They have 60 days to deposit to IRA; payroll needs to flag taxable withholding. We can provide guidance but cannot reverse withholding — they may need to file to reclaim. Recommend they do direct rollover next time.

jack: I'll ping the manager to pause final bonus payout until we verify rollover flag so there's no extra confusion. :eyes:

elaine: I'll update the intake with the screenshots rules and attach vendor form templates. Tag me if you get anything ambiguous.

sophia: Thanks all — adding checklist to the offboarding packet and closing out once INT-4321 is complete. :thumbsup:
